item.title: IFZA Acquires IF HUB to Expand its Ecosystem
item.description: IFZA, one of the world’s leading Free Zone ecosystems for company incorporation and business growth, has announced the strategic acquisition of IF HUB, a Dubai-based integrated interior design, fit-out and multi-brand furniture specification company.
